title: Mandatory checkpoint roles dominate every accepted projection path

graph_model.role: semantic invariant enforced by one or more interchangeable nodes

theorem_contract: A concrete checkpoint instance is mandatory only if every accepted path traverses that node.
A semantic checkpoint role is mandatory when every accepted path contains some node implementing that role.
Alternative implementations may satisfy the same mandatory role without either concrete node being individually mandatory.
Any bypass path that reaches the endpoint while omitting a required role is invalid.
invariant: Compress representation between role-dominating checkpoints, but never introduce a path that bypasses a required role.
boundary: This is a graph-contract theorem for HF01 artifact design, not evidence that these four roles are universally sufficient for all biomedical reasoning.
